cause_quote: The new foreign-slot branch called `await runSelectedMemoryProviderStatus(opts, runtimeConfig, slotOwner)` and returned before command secret resolution, so the provider received the raw `cfg`.
user_saw: Memory status and Doctor could report an invalid API key for a memory plugin that was working through the Gateway.
summary: Memory status and Doctor now resolve the selected memory plugin’s declared SecretRefs before probing its health and report it as unavailable if resolution fails.
reasoning: The #162175 diff introduced foreign-provider health reporting in memory status and passed the raw configuration through the new path from its first version. I also checked #162176, which added Doctor’s foreign-provider health probe and independently passed the raw configuration from its first version. The cited cause is the first of those two additions.
